notes.title: V1.12 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue when rapidly clicking the stock pile and obtaining a wildcard.
- Fixed saver achievement so it triggers at >=50000 instead of >50000.
- Deleted Dialogs/MoreGamesDialog.png as it wasn't being used.
- Changed Shadowhand to Shadowhand Solitaire on the More Games dialog.
- Added a Shadowhand Solitaire news popup (only shows once) and a slide on news icon to the title screen. We've done this because the best way to let our fans know about our new games is via cross-promotion from the older games and, as an indie micro-studio, every little thing we can do helps.

notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now change language for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

tags.feature: You can now change language for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

notes.title: Update V1.11 Multi-language support!
notes.content:
- You can now change language via the options screen. Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese.

Please note: at present we do not plan to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio and cannot afford to do so, but we welcome fan translations if people want to do that.

tags.feature: - You can now change language via the options screen. Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese.

notes.title: V1.08 Includes Steam Deck Enhancements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/62b977598fa2b3ef1185594634999aea2591eca9.jpg[/img]
We are happy to share a game update that includes features to make the game play even better on Steam Deck!

Here are the details:

[b]V1.08[/b]
[u]Steam Deck enhancements:[/u]
- Tapping the wildcard fan will now bring up a wildcard selection panel to make it easier to select an individual wildcard.
- The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Boosted the font size in various places if running on Steam Deck.
- Replaced "Click to continue" on the first story dialog with "Tap to continue" and made it larger.
- Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Hid the "Set as Wallpaper" button on Steam Deck because it's not applicable.
[u]
General:[/u]
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.

[u]V1.05-V1.07[/u]
- Game Name (on Window title bar) now includes Collector's Edition.
- Locked wallpapers now say "Locked" instead of "???"
- Deleted unused VO1a.ogg file
- Fixed an issue where the Resume Chapter dialog showed the wrong chapter number if you were previously playing a Collector's Edition chapter and had just loaded the game.

Enjoy!

- In Hard mode you will be warned if you didn't get a perfect hand and clicked Next.

notes.title: Peruse our dev diaries!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/e18158d73ec82e0ec8940b8f693946f1b7771a93.gif[/img]

Interested in our development progress / process for Regency Solitaire II?

We have a series of detailed posts [url=https://www.patreon.com/collection/84285]here [/url]on our progress. 
[h1]
[h2]a few highlights...[/h2][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/d6b8eda4701eaf931deeebd5171abe92c9fbedf2.png[/img]
Since Regency Solitaire, we've doubled the amount of power ups, which led to us designing this new UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/33d126eae2b58ae658a70956cda746eaf67a94c8.gif[/img]
Here's our Pall Mall mallet in action

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/98f3a109b51af6c52f1cdd2496dbe0335fe08ddf.jpg[/img]
Bella has many delectable new wardrobe items to collect. What's more, she is creating a new landscaped garden, with the help of an up-and-coming garden designer, Maplethorpe Green.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/8cb9d3b9ba9375ae5b21661c8ff2305bb838c71c.jpg[/img]
...and of course there is a new romance story, filled with intrigue and played out across lavish historical locations around Britain.

[h1]...wait, there's even more![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/7e54dfc56768b843b9d627ccba6655e66038a3ef.png[/img]
The gossip sheets will certainly be buzzing with an [b]entire extra romance story[/b] and other bonus features which unlock once you finish the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/a596bdacfbc2527a9bdce0ebcbb74c8da7187066.png[/img]

This is just a whirlwind tour: You can learn much more about the sumptuous details and diversions we have included, and of course lots of technical info about design, music, sound, code...

So we would love to invite you to dive in to our developer diaries [url=https://www.patreon.com/collection/84285]here[/url].

[i]And don't forget to wishlist Regency Solitaire II and tell your friends![/i]
